column7: On a SQLite host with a fixed non-UTC zone, GORM's NowFunc stamped created_at/updated_at in the host zone after every BeforeSave hook, machine_identities.updated_at was stored as a zoned string that GetMachineIdentity could not scan, and POST /projects/{id}/machine-identities/{id}/tokens answered 404 because machineInProject reports any read error as not found: a denial of service for machine-credential issuance. gormConfig NowFunc now returns UTC (red at origin/main: zoned created_at text; green at HEAD; Postgres leg in TestGormNowFunc_StoresUTCOnNonUTCHost_Postgres)
